Koha Community duyurusuna göre KohaCon27, Türkiye Cumhuriyeti Kültür ve Turizm Bakanlığı Kütüphaneler ve Yayımlar Genel Müdürlüğü ev sahipliğinde İstanbul Rami Kütüphanesi’nde düzenlenecek.                                 Directorate of Libraries Contact Koha Project Team kohacon27@ktb.gov.tr Format HYBRID Physical attendance at Rami Library +
                            High-quality live streaming via Koha Community YouTube channel. Planning Period Autumn
                                    2027 Main Plan Spring 2027 Backup Plan KÜRESEL KOHA HAFIZASI Bir konferanstan fazlası: KohaCon yaşayan bir açık kaynak laboratuvarıdır. Resmî KohaCon listesi 2009–2025 arasında 17 tamamlanmış konferansı, 12 ev sahibi ülkeyi ve 6 kıtayı kapsıyor. Konuşmalar, çalıştaylar, kültür günleri ve hackfest kayıtları tek bir doğrulanmış arşivde. KohaCon arşivini keşfet → 17 tamamlanmış KohaCon 12 ev sahibi ülke 6 kıta 25+ yıllık Koha mirası The Venue Rami
                        Library ramikutuphanesi.gov.tr (yeni sekmede açılır) Facilities Hackfest Transport Accommodation Capacity 4,200 Seating
                                    Capacity. Multiple seminar halls. AV & WiFi Professional
                                    hybrid streaming infrastructure. Social Cafes and
                                    massive courtyard garden. "Developers need
                        power, coffee, and silence." 24/7 Access for developers. High-density power outlets. Dedicated high-speed fiber internet. Airports Istanbul (IST) ~35 min Sabiha Gokcen (SAW) ~60 min Istanbul is a global flight hub
                                connecting all continents. City Access Accessible via Tram (Rami Station) and Bus. 20 minutes from the Historic Peninsula. Nearby Hotels & Logistics Istanbul offers a wide range of accommodation options. We recommend staying around the
                                Historic Peninsula (Sultanahmet/Eminönü) area for easy access to both cultural sites and
                                the conference venue. The T4 Tram line provides direct access to the Rami Library gates. Budget Friendly Premium Boutique Why Istanbul? Executive
                        Summary: Technical Authority & Strategic Bridge Turkey is not merely a venue provider, but a technical authority hosting one of the world's
                        largest centralized Koha installations with over 1,300 branches and 30 million materials.
                        Istanbul serves as a strategic bridge connecting continents and code, embodied by the Rami
                        Library's "Living Library" concept. No Vendor Lock-in Open source ensures
                        data freedom and prevents commercial monopolies. Data Sovereignty Aligns with the
                        global movement for nations to own their cultural data. Sustainability Zero license fees for
                        1,300 libraries. A sustainable model. Global Accessibility Easy
                        visa policies (e-Visa) and non-stop flights from 120+ countries make it accessible for the
                        entire community. Unmatched Value Premium
                        accommodation and world-class hospitality at significantly competitive costs for international participants. Strategic Bridge A
                        unique chance to expand Koha's presence in the Middle East and Central Asia through Istanbul's
                        leadership. The Scale Challenge 1,300 Libraries, 1
                        Instance Most large
                        Koha setups are consortiums of independent databases. In Turkey, we run 1,300+ libraries on a
                        single centralized Koha instance. 30M+ Items 7M+ Users (MERNIS) 6M+ Bibliographic Recs Tech Stack Perl, MariaDB, Elastic 1,300 975 650 325 0 150 Others 1,300 KYGM (Türkiye) Draft
                    Event Schedule A standard 6-day
                    KohaCon experience adapted for Istanbul. Days 1
                            - 3 Conference Keynotes, lightning talks, and roundtables hosted at the Rami Library main seminar halls. Fully
                        hybrid and streamed globally. Day 4 - 5 Cultural Day A curated tour through the Historic Peninsula, followed by a networking Gala Dinner on the
                        Bosphorus. Days 5 - 6 Hackfest Intensive collaborative work for developers and librarians. 24/7 access to Rami Library
                        workspaces. Discover Istanbul Filled with historic landmarks and monuments, Istanbul is also
                    home to numerous chic boutiques, cool restaurants, and customer-oriented boutique eateries.
                    Embracing 'The New Cool', Istanbul feels stylish. Nature &

                        in hand with the present and every step brings to light a relic of times gone by. At the
                        crossroads of two continents - Europe and Asia - this spectacular city has absorbed the best of
                        both worlds. With its beautiful historic landmarks, quintessential cuisine, vibrant nightlife,
                        festivals of art and music, celebration of faith, labyrinths of marketplaces and shopping
                        arcades, the beating heart of İstanbul, and the soul of Bosphorus under the watchful eye of the
                        Maiden's Tower is a traveller's dream. Featured
